Flock of shit draft-
Synopsis: the flock of shit are the underbelly of the underbelly pigeon society. They resort to the most uncouth of tactics to do away with opponents and leave the foulest stench with those who survive. Be warned, the pigeons behind this flock do not discriminate between friends or foes.

well poop: your pigeons release more than simple arcane energy with their spells: excrement. As you cast a spell, creatures in the radius of the spell or within 10 ft of a targeted creature gain excrement stacks equal to the spells level. Creatures that have excrement stacks have disadvantage on charisma ability checks and take an additional point of damage for each excrement on them during the next damage roll you make against them.

load of shit: creatures who carry excrement may find it hard to move. You can spend your reaction to reduce a creature’s movement speed by 5 ft for each stack of excrement.

light’em up stinky: you can spend your bonus action and all excrement on a single target to deal 1d4 fire damage and 1d4 poison damage for each stack of excrement on that chosen target.

pop a squat: the pigeon lord learns the ways of excrement, able to leave a squatter that you can use as a signal for the pigeons to cast their spells near there treating it as you for a spells range. The squat lasts for 1 minute before it stales as a signal. Once you pop a squat you cannot do so again until you complete a short rest or spend 3 bread to use it again.
